title: Bounded cleanup time
responsibility: Creates a shared deadline that ends waits and supplies fallback answers when cleanup work fails or takes too long.

inputs.name: cleanupDeadline.milliseconds
inputs.description: Milliseconds before the deadline aborts. A timer starts immediately and is unreferenced so it does not keep the process alive.

outputs.name: cleanupDeadline
outputs.description: Deadline with an AbortSignal, expiry check, promise race with fallback, bounded pause and cancel method. Cancellation aborts immediately; within returns its fallback for failed or late work without stopping work that ignores the signal.
